# Grug Digital

> Grug Digital makes playful web tools and games. The new site is being rebuilt at this address; the old site is still
> served at its old paths.

## Avatar Studio (Roblox characters)

- [Avatar Studio](https://grugdigital.pages.dev/character/): a browser app (WebGL) that makes a blocky Roblox R6
  character: hair, face, a custom shirt and pants painted with an AI image editor (Gemini / Nano Banana), and a rigged
  `.glb` download.
- [Guide for Claude and other AI agents](https://grugdigital.pages.dev/character/claude.md): how to make a character
  for someone who pasted the studio's link into a chat, step by step, including the `window.GrugStudio` JavaScript API
  and recipe links (`/character/?hair=…&outfit=…`) for when you can't use a browser.
